title: Two offcuts are not one long piece
hook: A 90cm piece and a 50cm piece cannot supply two unjoined 60cm lengths.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Respect indivisible stock-piece boundaries when counting reusable offcuts.

misconception: Adding offcut lengths makes them equivalent to one continuous piece.
objective: Respect indivisible stock-piece boundaries when counting reusable offcuts.

claims.text: Unjoined usable pieces must each be 60cm. The available offcuts are 90cm and 50cm, with zero modeled cut loss. Scaled model; no joining; cut loss=0; lengths only.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Piece-size=60cm, A=60cm and B=120cm. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+",["*",["floor",["/",90,"x"]],"x"],["*",["floor",["/",50,"x"]],"x"]]; B=["*",["floor",["/",140,"x"]],"x"]; x denotes Piece-size. At x=60, A=60, B=120; recall at x=75: B=75. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. claims.text: Each required piece has to fit within one offcut. Count fits separately before adding them. Summing lengths first invents continuity between the two offcuts; the pooled result is an intentionally infeasible comparison.
